note: Which object families may declare a model preference for the shared LLM plane, and HOW. RULE: a preference is declared BY REFERENCE — a model_preference_ref pointing at an InferencePreference (preference_id) — NEVER an inline raw preference, provider name match, API key, or secret. The Inference Gateway resolves the ref (global→product→tenant→env→object-type→instance→call inheritance) and records the ACTUAL model used in a ModelInvocationReceipt. Declaring a preference is NOT choosing a model; the gateway + policy + fallback decide, and the receipt records reality.
declared_via: ObjectShell.model_preference_ref (string ref) — or an object-family schema's own model_preference_ref
